description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating bounding boxes, including conversions between formats, IoU calculations, Generalized IoU, and generating bounding boxes from masks. It is part of an object detection project, providing core geometric operations for bounding box processing.

methods.name: box_cxcywh_to_xyxy(x)
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from center-x, center-y, width, height format to corner coordinates (xyxy).

methods.name: box_xyxy_to_cxcywh(x)
methods.description: Converts bounding boxes from corner coordinates (xyxy) to center-x, center-y, width, height format.

methods.name: box_iou(boxes1, boxes2)
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection-over-Union (IoU) and union areas between two sets of boxes.

methods.name: generalized_box_iou(boxes1, boxes2)
methods.description: Calculates the Generalized IoU between two sets of boxes, accounting for the spatial relationship beyond the intersection.

methods.name: masks_to_boxes(masks)
methods.description: Computes bounding boxes (in xyxy format) around masks, given mask tensors.
